description.en: Gives an item with the usual jingle and the "sysmes-item-get" message: RunGetItemEx(_item, _num, 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-item-get"). The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_08 plays while the message shows.

examples.case: Receiving an item (real usage, from ev42010400.nut)
